summary: Review flashcards anywhere, even without Wi-Fi.
page_description: Study Anki decks with large reveal and answer controls. Cards you grade come back on their own schedule, and missed cards return before the session ends.
release_notes: On a Kobo Clara Colour or Libra Colour card images are shown in colour. Black-and-white readers look exactly as before.

steps.text: Or start with the sample deck in the app, no computer needed.
Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Export a deck from Anki and turn it into a collection on this computer.
Send the collection to the reader over Wi-Fi. Grades on the reader are kept.
